title: Efficiency Flows: Mini walkthroughs and scaffold assets for Optimize toolkit
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a set of compact, reusable mini-walkthrough assets and scaffold screens for the Optimize toolkit onboarding flow. These assets should surface batching, KV caching, and quantization recommendations in a low-friction way for first-run users and in-console quick reference. Design should prioritize clarity for engineers and product owners: recommended settings per workload archetype, lightweight explanations, and one-click apply where possible.
tasks: Design 3 compact walkthrough cards (Latency-first, Cost-first, Balanced) with primary CTAs and tertiary 'Learn more' links
Create two scaffold screens to slot into Console: 'Quick Recommendations' and 'Simulate impact'
Produce screenshot-ready variants for marketing/docs (desktop, narrow desktop, and tablet) with placeholder copy and realistic telemetry values
Write microcopy for recommendations and tooltips (including fallback copy when metrics are missing)
Export redlines, tokens, and interaction specs for engineering handoff
Coordinate with PM and Runtime engineer to validate recommended default values and API mapping
acceptance_criteria: Three card variants with clear primary action and accessible labels created in Figma
Scaffold screens include a working 'Apply recommendation' state and a disabled state with reason copy
All copy approved by PM and Localization lead (strings scoped and marked for i18n)
Handoff package (Figma, tokens.json, and a PRD link) uploaded and linked in ticket
Design review completed and sign-off from Engineering on API mapping for 'Apply' action
screenshot_specs: Desktop: 1280x720, annotated overlays for primary CTA and telemetry
Narrow desktop: 1024x600, cards stacked two-high with collapsed details
Tablet: 834x1112, single-column walkthrough with touch targets >= 44px
microcopy_snippets: Latency-first card title: 'Speed-first: minimize latency for real-time features'
Cost-first card title: 'Cost-first: maximize throughput for batch jobs'
Balanced card title: 'Balanced: trade latency and cost for steady MRLs'
Fallback tooltip copy: 'We don’t have enough recent telemetry to recommend a profile. Try running a 10k token sample or import a workload trace.'
decisions: Use 3 archetype cards rather than a long list of toggles to reduce cognitive load for new users
Hide advanced quantization tuning behind an 'Advanced settings' modal to avoid overwhelming first-run users
Show simulated delta for token cost and median p95 latency inline on cards; accurate enough for onboarding but labeled as an estimate
The 'Apply recommendation' action will call a single Console API endpoint -> /api/optimize/apply with payload mapping documented in PRD
review_feedback: PM (R. Alvarez): prefer 'Simulate impact' to be available before apply so customers can see a rough delta
Runtime Eng (S. Kumar): confirm default batch sizes for 'Balanced' on A100 vs T4 — flagged as dependency
Accessibility (L. Novak): ensure contrast ratio for telemetry badges and that status icons have text alternatives
Localization (J. Becker): shorten card titles to 40 characters for safe translations
